task: For a US equities macro-risk review, compare QQQ and SPY over calendar months in 2016–2025 when the US 10-year Treasury yield rose at least 25 basis points, fell at least 25 basis points or moved less. Report observation counts, average and median returns, the worst monthly return and QQQ performance relative to SPY. Return a regime table and a concise Markdown assessment.
context: Persona: a US equities desk. Use real observations available through configured Epoch data sources. This is an analysis request, not an order to trade.

Calculate numerical results in the saved study, inspect the actual execution evidence, and publish exactly the requested named outputs. Tables must reference saved computed relations and fields; do not enumerate or invent market observations.

Preserve actual source, coverage, fiscal/calendar basis, corporate-action policy and retrieval time. If required data or a capability is unavailable, report the concrete gap; do not substitute another security, source definition, period or model assumption.
The published answer is the response. Do not repeat it in a separate assistant narrative or create a matching dashboard table merely because a table response was requested.

Discover the daily US 10-year nominal Treasury constant-maturity yield, quoted as an annual percentage yield, through a configured macro source. Its economic definition is the Fed H.15 10-year constant-maturity Treasury series. Do not substitute a bond ETF return, another maturity, a real yield or another country.

Evaluate exactly January 2016 through December 2025. Load December 2015 prices and yields for the initial month-over-month comparison. Use a consistent dividend-inclusive total-return convention for QQQ and SPY.

For each calendar month use the last valid equity session and the latest valid yield observation no later than that date. Convert changes in percentage-point quoted yields to basis points by multiplying by 100. Do not carry a yield from a prior month when that month has no observation.

Regimes are monthly yield change >= +25 bp, <= -25 bp, and strictly between -25 and +25 bp. Apply each regime to the same month's equity returns: this is a contemporaneous descriptive association, not a tradable signal, a causal estimate or a forecast.

Use complete paired months only. State source, return basis, dates, sample count and any excluded months in the assessment. Publish all three regime rows, using null metrics only for an empty regime. Compute active median/worst returns from paired QQQ-minus-SPY observations rather than subtracting separate medians/minima.

outputs.name: rate_regimes
outputs.description: Three labelled regime rows; the row index is a category, not a date.

schema.name: regime
schema.description: yields_up_25bp, yields_down_25bp or other; in that order.

schema.name: month_count
schema.description: Number of complete paired calendar months in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_mean_return
schema.description: Arithmetic mean of QQQ monthly total returns in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_median_return
schema.description: Median QQQ monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum QQQ monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: spy_mean_return
schema.description: Arithmetic mean of SPY monthly total returns in the regime.

schema.name: spy_median_return
schema.description: Median SPY monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: spy_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum SPY monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: active_mean_return
schema.description: Mean of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns.

schema.name: active_median_return
schema.description: Median of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns; not the difference between marginal medians.

schema.name: active_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns.

outputs.name: macro_assessment
outputs.instructions: Write at most 180 words for the desk. Describe the observed QQQ versus SPY relationship and sample sizes without claiming causation or a predictive strategy. State actual source, total-return basis, complete/missing months and alignment policy. Do not repeat the table as prose or create another Markdown table.
